title: Djinnlang: Higher-Level Programming by Unambiguous Specification with an LLM in the Compiler
abstract: arXiv:2609.23954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Programmers write formal specifications, and LLMs implement them, proving that each implementation matches its spec. Taken to its extreme, this makes specification languages the new programming languages. We argue that an unambiguity constraint is key: in addition to proving that its implementation satisfies the specification, the LLM must also prove that any other implementation satisfying it must produce the same outputs on the same inputs, i.e. that the relation formed by the constraints is deterministic. This leaves the LLM no leeway on program semantics: as with a conventional compiler, the generated code never needs to be read and can be regenerated from the spec at any time. Under this constraint and with a powerful LLM, the difference between a specification language and a programming language becomes essentially meaningless, and the LLM essentially becomes a part of the compiler toolchain. translated_title: Djinnlang：通过无歧义规范与编译器中的LLM实现更高层次的编程
translated_abstract: 程序员编写形式化规范，由大语言模型（LLM）来实现这些规范，并证明每个实现都与规范相匹配。将这一理念推向极致，规范语言将成为新的编程语言。我们认为无歧义性约束是关键：除了证明其实现满足规范之外，LLM还必须证明任何其他满足该规范的实现，在相同输入下都会产生相同的输出，即约束所形成的关系是确定性的。这使得LLM在程序语义上没有任何自由发挥的空间：就像传统编译器一样，生成的代码永远无需被阅读，并且可以随时从规范重新生成。在这一约束下，配合强大的LLM，规范语言与编程语言之间的区别基本上变得毫无意义，LLM本质上成为了编译器工具链的一部分。这种安排同时也作为一种强大的……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Djinnlang语言，其核心创新是要求LLM证明规范的无歧义性（即任何满足规范的实现都产生相同输出），从而使规范语言成为新的编程语言，LLM则成为编译器工具链的一部分。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Djinnlang, whose key innovation is requiring the LLM to prove the unambiguity of specifications—any implementation satisfying a spec must produce identical outputs—thereby making specification languages the new programming languages and turning the LLM into part of the compiler toolchain.
